note: Order games. 'seerah': events in the order the Seerah School tells them (the story numbers must rise; each 'fact' must appear word for word in that story). 'prophets': rounds in which every pair is ordered by something the Messengers' tree states: Adam is the first man and first prophet, Muhammad is the Seal of the Prophets, or one is an Established ancestor of the other. Tested in test/games/learning_games_test.dart.

events.label: Born in the Year of the Elephant
events.fact: the Prophet ﷺ was born on a Monday, the twelfth of Rabi' al-Awwal, in the Year of the Elephant

events.label: The first revelation in the cave of Hira
events.fact: In the month of Ramadan, in the year he turned forty, the silence ended.

events.label: The Hijrah: the cave of Thawr
events.fact: entered a cave in Mount Thawr, below the city

events.label: Arrival in Madinah
events.fact: Clan after clan stopped his camel and invited him to stay with them

events.label: Badr
events.fact: The Qur'an later named the day: 'the day of criterion - the day when the two armies met' (8:41).

events.label: Uhud
events.fact: The archers held the pass behind the Muslims as ordered

events.label: The Trench
events.fact: The Prophet ﷺ ordered a trench dug around Madinah

events.label: Hudaybiyyah
events.fact: the two sides agreed to put war away from the people for ten years

events.label: The Conquest of Makkah
events.fact: In Ramadan of the eighth year the Prophet ﷺ camped at Marr al-Zahran with ten thousand Muslims

events.label: Tabuk
events.fact: the Prophet ﷺ ordered the Muslims to prepare to fight the Romans — Tabuk, in the year nine

events.label: The Farewell Sermon
events.fact: In the tenth year, the Prophet ﷺ performed his only full pilgrimage

events.label: The passing of the Prophet ﷺ
events.fact: After the farewell pilgrimage and the sending of Usama's army, the illness began
